comment: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT (CLAUDE.md 2026-07-27). Every question and every term below is synthetic, pending Legal review. Structure is what the system relies on; wording is not. No test pins any string in this file.

probes.asks: Describe what you are buying and why the business needs it.
Which supplier is this for, and have we worked with them before?
What is the expected total value of this engagement?
Will the supplier receive, store, or process any personal data — customer, employee, or otherwise?
What could go wrong in this engagement, and what would it cost the business if it did?
How long should this arrangement run, and how would we exit it?
